hybrid_alpha.description: Weight for vector vs BM25 fusion (0=BM25 only, 1=vector only)

context_budget_tokens.description: Max tokens to include in context window from retrieved chunks

min_relevance_score.description: Minimum cosine similarity (1 - Chroma distance) of a chunk's best vector match, evaluated after RRF fusion. Chunks below this score are dropped from the citation list before being returned to agent-runtime, so an out-of-scope question can yield zero citations and trigger the D-036 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE guard deterministically instead of relying on the answer prompt alone. 0 disables filtering (returns top_k regardless of relevance, the pre-D-046 behavior). D-046 measured this default from the seeded 재택근무 정책 Knowledge index: with the Qwen3 instruct query prefix, in-scope top-1 similarity was 0.446–0.709 and out-of-scope was 0.196–0.391 — 0.42 sits in that separation gap. A chunk found only via BM25 (no vector similarity available) is treated as failing this threshold and is dropped whenever filtering is enabled, since there is no cosine-similarity evidence it is relevant.

Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:
query_instruct_prefix.description: Text prepended to the query (query side only, never applied to indexed document text) before embedding it for vector search. Required for min_relevance_score to be a meaningful threshold: Qwen3-Embedding is trained for asymmetric retrieval and its raw-text query embeddings do not cleanly separate in-scope from out-of-scope questions (D-046 measured a -0.034 overlap without the prefix vs. +0.056 separation with it). Set to an empty string to disable the prefix for embedding models that do not use this convention; indexing-runtime is unaffected either way and does not need re-indexing when this changes.
